Role: AI/ML / GenAI Python Engineer
Experience: 7 to 10 Years
Location: Bangalore
Employment Type: Full-Time




What the Company Is Looking For

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML / Generative AI Python Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Python, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and AI application development. The ideal candidate should have a strong programming foundation and experience building and deploying production-grade AI/GenAI solutions.




Mandatory Skills

Strong hands-on experience in Python programming
710 years of experience in AI/ML and software engineering
Strong experience in Generative AI / GenAI
Hands-on experience with LLMs (Large Language Models)
Strong understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Milvus, or Weaviate
Experience with Machine Learning and AI concepts
Hands-on experience in developing AI/GenAI applications and solutions
Strong knowledge of Prompt Engineering and LLM integration
Experience with AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LlamaIndex
Strong problem-solving and programming skills
Experience deploying AI/ML solutions in production environments



Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions using Python.
Build and integrate LLM-powered applications and RAG-based solutions.
Develop AI solutions using Vector Databases and semantic search.
Work on prompt engineering, model integration, and AI application development.
Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams.
Develop scalable and production-ready AI/ML pipelines and applications.
Optimize AI solutions for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Stay updated with emerging GenAI, LLM, RAG, and AI/ML technologies.
